Run a program on this computer when something happens, with the event as JSON on its input.
Each event arrives as JSON on the program's input. It runs directly, never through a shell, and is stopped with anything it started after the time limit.

Let a web address or a program change your words, before or after AI cleanup.
FioriVoce posts the words as JSON. Reply {"text": "…"} to change them, {} to keep them, or {"cancel": true} to paste nothing. A slow or odd reply keeps your words.
